title: Butt Detective TV Anime Gets New Episodes Starting Next April
content: The staff for the Butt Detective ( Oshiri Tantei ) anime announced on Wednesday that the anime will have new episodes that will premiere in April 2027. The staff made the announcement on November 4, which has the nickname "Nice Butt Day" ("Ii Oshiri no Hi") since "11/04" can be read as a Japanese wordplay on "ii oshi"…

title: 'Watashi wo Center ni Suru to Chikaimasu ka?' Reveals Main Cast, Staff, Opening Theme, Teaser Promo
content: The official website of the Watashi wo Center ni Suru to Chikaimasu ka? ( Promise Me the Spotlight ) television anime revealed the main cast, staff, a key visual (pictured), the opening theme, and a teaser promotional video on Wednesday.

title: Promise Me the Spotlight Anime Unveils Teaser, Main Cast, Staff
content: Bandai Namco Filmworks revealed on Wednesday the teaser trailer, key visual, main cast, and main staff members for the television anime of Jun Wakatsuki 's Promise Me the Spotlight ( Watashi o Center ni Suru to Chikaimasuka? ) manga.
author: ANN

title: Pero Pero★Sparkles Anime Reveals Cast, Staff, January Debut
content: The official website for the television anime of Yurie Sekiya 's Pero Pero★Sparkles characters revealed the cast, staff, January premiere on TV Tokyo , and a new key visual for the anime on Wednesday.
author: ANN

title: Kemono Jihen Manga's Climax Is 'Imminent'
content: The December issue of Shueisha 's Jump SQ. magazine confirmed on Wednesday that the story climax of Shō Aimoto 's Kemono Jihen manga is "imminent." The 25th compiled book volume, which shipped on August 4, announced that the series will end in the next volume.
author: ANN

title: Witch on the Holy Night Film Gets Manga Adaptation
content: This year's 49th issue of Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine announced on Wednesday that the Witch on the Holy Night ( Mahōtsukai no Yoru ) anime film will receive a manga adaptation by Keigo Maki ( Shikimori's Not Just a Cutie ) in the next issue on November 11.
author: ANN

title: Otaku Vampire's Love Bite Anime Adaptation Announced
content: Otaku Vampire’s Love Bite manga by Julietta Suzuki ( Kamisama Kiss ) is getting an anime adaptation. A teaser visual and a special trailer were released. The studio, staff, and cast have yet to be announced. The manga has been serialized in Hakusensha’s shojo manga magazine Hana to Yume since November 2022.
author: Anime Corner

title: Crunchyroll’s Hottest New Protagonist Is a Perfect Example of How Modern Anime Heroes Should Be Written
content: The Fall 2026 season’s darkest and spookiest anime airing on Crunchyroll has the perfect modern protagonist that most new anime are embracing. Older anime, especially shonen series, have always followed a particular format when it comes to their protagonists.
